# Alibaba Coding Plan

Use `alibaba-coding-plan/<model>` with VoltAgent's model router.

## Quick start

```ts
import { Agent } from "@voltagent/core";

const agent = new Agent({
  name: "alibaba-coding-plan-agent",
  instructions: "You are a helpful assistant",
  model: "alibaba-coding-plan/MiniMax-M2.5",
});
```

## Environment variables

- `ALIBABA_CODING_PLAN_API_KEY`

## Provider package

`@ai-sdk/openai-compatible`

This provider uses the OpenAI-compatible adapter.

## Default base URL

`https://coding-intl.dashscope.aliyuncs.com/v1`

You can override the base URL by setting `ALIBABA_CODING_PLAN_BASE_URL`.
